about_the_game:
A small crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges! In Dungeon Gals, you'll take control of 3 distinct (and pretty!) girls each with their own unique playstyle and abilities. As you navigate wild landscapes and areas, each of their abilities will be needed, and you'll have to swap between them to find treasure, complete quests, and battle enemies. Along the way, you'll interact with townspeople, find goodies, and more!

This game features the following:
  • Native Gameboy Resolution & Presentation, upscaled for your liking!
  • 9 main areas filled with puzzles and treasures
  • Lots of extra goodies & hidden unlockables to find
  • Expansive FM soundtrack, including all sorts of genres and styles
  • FM slap bass
  • Hand drawn artwork sized down to pixel art without filter
  • An adorable goat girl
  • A Moth GF
  • Bimbo cow lady
  • Seriously, what more could you possibly want???

Meet The Cast:
Wendy

A goat girl who can use a magical amulet to zap all sorts of things, including enemies and switches!

Izzy

A cow girl who specializes in using brute force. She can destroy walls, ram into enemies, and help you get into all sorts of hidden areas.

Rosa

A small moth girl who is skilled with swordplay and flight. It can use its wings to reach high areas and blow deadly gusts of wind. It can also repel enemy projectiles with it's sword!
